results.citation: 2,2,3,3-tetramethyloxirane (tetramethylethylene oxide, CAS 5076-20-0), C6H12O MW 100.16 -- commercially available synthesis reagent (Sigma-Aldrich), never sold or classified by any supplier as a coatings epoxy resin. Both oxirane carbons are fully substituted (quaternary, zero ring C-H), sterically blocking the backside nucleophilic approach an amine curing agent needs to open the ring (Parker & Isaacs 1959, Chem. Rev. 59(4):737-799, DOI 10.1021/cr50028a006, Sec. III)
results.note: steric-shielding hostile null on the RESIN side: a formally valid oxirane ring (O degree-2, both ring bonds single, no charge) that passes every existing clause in count_oxirane_rings (there are none besides ring topology) but has no accessible epoxide carbon for amine ring-opening -- categorically unlike the glycidyl-ether motif this module's own theory anchor requires

results.citation: 2,2,3-trimethyloxirane (2,3-epoxy-2-methylbutane, CAS 5076-19-7), C5H10O MW 86.13 -- commercially available synthesis reagent, never sold or classified as a coatings epoxy resin. results.note: second, independent hostile null at a different substitution grade, showing the gap is a substitution-blind continuum, not one pathological molecule

results.citation: phenyl glycidyl ether (PGE, CAS 122-60-1), C9H10O2 MW 150.17 -- real, commercially marketed epoxy reactive diluent used in coating formulations; unhindered terminal glycidyl epoxide carbon (CH2, only the -O-Ar substituent) matching the theory anchor's glycidyl-ether motif
results.note: positive comparator: a genuine, unhindered glycidyl-ether resin SHOULD be admitted; if the gate cannot distinguish this from the fully-hindered probes above despite the drastic difference in real nucleophilic ring-opening rate, the gate is using bare oxirane-ring topology as a complete proxy for resin-appropriate reactivity with no steric term

results.citation: oxetane (CAS 503-30-0), C3H6O MW 58.08 -- four-membered cyclic ether, structurally adjacent to but distinct from a three-membered oxirane
results.note: internal specificity control: confirms the PRE-EXISTING ring-size clause in count_oxirane_rings still correctly rejects a non-oxirane cyclic ether -- isolates that the finding under test is substitution-blindness WITHIN valid 3-membered rings, not a wholesale failure of ring detection
